item.description:
### Added - **Each Claude session shows its permission mode.** The line under a session's name now says "auto", "manual", "plan", "accept edits" or "bypass", next to the model and context. Claude Code now starts in auto mode unless you choose otherwise, and in auto mode it rarely stops to ask for approval, so a session that never needs you is no longer a mystery. The iPhone shows the same with its next update.
### Fixed - **A Claude session waiting for you after a usage limit now says so.** If your limit reset while the Mac was asleep, Claude Code waits for you to press Enter before it carries on, and Perch showed the session as idle. It now shows as needing you. A session that resumed on its own goes back to running, and one that gave up waiting says why.
